Hi all —

Thanks Marissa / Anna. A few procurement/AP guardrails so Bluewave can standardize the feed:

Policy preference:
- Preferred: Redwood vendor portal (single source; we validate PO pinning at upload).
- Acceptable during onboarding: SMTP/email ingestion to invoicing@redwood.com if emails include the structured subject token pattern (see below) or a CSV attachment with the required header fields.

Subject token pattern (when emailing):
- Please include a single-line subject token at the start of the subject following this exact format: INV|PO:<PO_NUMBER>|LEDGER:<LEDGER_CODE>
- Example: INV|PO:987654|LEDGER:US-GA

CSV schema (required headers if sending CSV):
- invoice_number, invoice_date (YYYY-MM-DD), po_number, line_number, description, quantity, unit_price, tax_amount, currency, ledger_code, supplier_invoice_total

Notes on line items and taxes:
- We accept line-level tax fields (tax_amount) but require supplier_invoice_total to match the sum of (quantity*unit_price)+tax across lines.
- If your system collapses lines, include a single line with description "Summary" and include line_number = 0.

Acknowledgement SLA:
- Automated ack sent within 24 hours for valid submissions. Ack payload will include an ingest_id (UUID) and an ISO8601 timestamp. Use that ingest_id in any dispute or reconciliation requests.

Technical fallback:
- If email ingestion fails for any reason, we can accept a secure SFTP drop (details available in our vendor portal) or a one-time portal upload.

Irene — can you confirm the exact ack payload fields AP will provide (I think it's ingest_id, received_at, mapped_po, and initial_status)?

Thanks,
Priyom Das

Hi Anna —

Short answers: the automated ack is sent as an email to the submitting address and contains the ingest_id (UUID), received_at (ISO8601), mapped_po, and initial_status (accepted / validation_error). We also write the same ack into our vendor portal under the Submission History for your account. There isn't a webhook option on day-one; we can evaluate webhook delivery for high-volume partners later.

Operational notes for your team before first send:
- Subject: if emailing, start subject exactly with the token (e.g. INV|PO:987654|LEDGER:US-GA) then a short human subject after a space.
- Header: include X-Partner-ID: BLUEWAVE in the SMTP headers where possible (helps routing if email is proxied).
- Attachments: prefer CSV + PDF together. If PDF only, ensure the PO is prominent on page 1.
- Reconciliations: reference the ingest_id in any follow-up and include the PO number. AP will open a ticket for validation errors within 48 hours.

I've uploaded the vendor-facing ingest spec (ingest_spec_v2.xlsx) to the vendor page: https://redwood.app/procurement/vendor/bluewave — it contains exact CSV examples and the ack JSON schema.

If this looks good, please send a test invoice this week and we'll confirm the automated ack and mapping.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
